record.question:
Which of the following is NOT CORRECT about the online movement, Cockroach Janta Party
    (CJP)?
options: It calls itself an Indian satirical political movement.
Abhijeet Dipke is the founder of CJP.
It organized demonstration at Jantar Mantar, Delhi on 6th June, 2026 which mainly demanded for resignation of the Union Education Minister, Dharmendra Pradhan.
The demonstration on 6th June 2026 at Jantar Mantar was attended by Sonam Wangchuk, the climate activist and General Secretary of CPI (ML).
